card.name: Dosing frequency before a duration
card.fires_on: The last word of a dose-frequency phrase such as "once daily", "three times a day" or "every 3 weeks", right before a duration like "for 5 days". Also the unit after a dose number when a frequency follows.

modes.label: Once daily
modes.description: The word daily after "once" in a dosing schedule, before a length of treatment.
modes.example: a 1 g oral dose once<< daily>> for 5 days taken with food.

modes.label: Every few weeks
modes.description: The word weeks after "every 3" in a cycle schedule.
modes.example: cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m 2 every 3<< weeks>> for 6 courses.

modes.label: Dose unit before frequency
modes.description: The unit mg after a dose amount, just before the frequency words.
modes.example: immediate-release capsules, 25<< mg>> three times a day.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about repeated counts or iterations and away from unrelated technical names.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of a dosing frequency like "once daily" or "every 3 weeks", where a length of treatment usually follows.
